Find the digital root of a number (keep adding digits until one digit is left).

Supplied answer
n = int(input("Enter a number: "))
while n > 9:
    total = 0
    while n > 0:
        total += n % 10
        n //= 10
    n = total
print("Digital root =", n) # 9875 -> 29 -> 11 -> 2
